name: claude-code-enhance
description: Adds LaTeX math rendering and enhanced output preview controls to Claude Code chat.

claudeCodeEnhance.fullTranscript.description: Keep the full Claude conversation mounted instead of applying Claude Code's built-in retention cap. This can use substantial memory in very long sessions.

claudeCodeEnhance.contentScale.description: Base scale applied to rendered conversation content.

claudeCodeEnhance.mathScale.description: Additional scale applied to inline and display mathematics.

claudeCodeEnhance.toolOutputMath.description: Render validated mathematics found in prose-oriented tool output while preserving code regions.

claudeCodeEnhance.syntaxHighlighting.description: Apply bundled syntax highlighting to Claude Code output blocks.

claudeCodeEnhance.copyButtons.description: Show copy controls for code blocks and assistant turns.

claudeCodeEnhance.apiErrorCards.description: Present API errors as structured, theme-aware diagnostic cards.

scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/rich-content-regression.js && node scripts/architecture-regression.js
